Definition: Integration of CRVS data (births, deaths, marriages) into data exchange for real-time verification and service eligibility
Comments: The National Registration Bureau (NRB) manages both civil registration and national ID. The national ID is linked with the civil registration system; a unique ID number is assigned at birth. Over 3.5 million births and death registrations are tracked in the system. Integration with voter registration and other systems is operational.

Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: Malawi's National ID (via NRB) is linked with over 33 public and private institutions. The national ID is used for voting (7.2 million in 2024 election), SIM registration, payroll verification, bank KYC, and social protection. A digital ID pilot has been completed and full rollout is planned. Every child now receives a national ID number at birth linked to the civil registration system.

Comments: The national ID is fully integrated with voter registration. In the 2024 election, 7.2 million Malawians voted using their digital IDs, with 2 million registered using offline digital IDs. The Malawi Electoral Commission (MEC) uses the national ID database.

Comments: The Malawi Healthcare Information System (MaHIS) is being scaled nationwide under the Digital Health Governance Framework (2025). The Digital Health Strategy (2020-2025) outlines interoperability frameworks. Integration is under development with national e-government platforms.

Definition: Integration of social assistance programs, grant registries, beneficiary management systems
Comments: The national ID has eliminated ghost beneficiaries, saving US$20 million in annual payments. National ID is integrated with social protection programs. The government reallocated USD 25 million to farmer subsidy programs thanks to fraud elimination. Banks use national ID for KYC, and the system underpins welfare delivery.

Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Malawi has the Data Protection Act (Act No. 3 of 2024), Electronic Transactions and Cyber Security Act (2016), National Registration Act (2010, revised 2015), Access to Information Act (2016/2017), and National Statistics Act (2013). These provide a legal basis for digital data sharing. The OGP Action Plan 2023-2025 explicitly commits to ICT-based harmonization and sharing of databases.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Malawi enacted the Data Protection Act (Act No. 3 of 2024) designating MACRA as the Data Protection Authority. The Act requires 72-hour breach notification, data protection impact assessments, and cross-border transfer safeguards. The Electronic Transactions and Cyber Security Act 2016 also applies. The OGP commitment includes controlling citizens' personal information. Enforcement implementation is ongoing.
